info.title: Wheelwright v2 Account evidence, Positions and transaction history
info.description: Bounded source retention, exact-row evidence admission and Position reads. No sophisticated historical reconciliation or recommendations. Canonical opaque resource identities, Account discovery and authorized-scope collections; persistence structure does not determine URI hierarchy. First-class User identity, authenticated self inspection and explicitly administrator-only User discovery; fixed many-to-many User–Account authorization. Account-nested transaction history is a retained-first backend facade with one explicit Account history grant and policy-bounded source acquisition. No strategy/tax/P&L interpretation. UNAPPROVED P2 DESIGN. No implementation or operational action authorized.

get.description: Existing default inventory, observations catalog and accountId+snapshotId historical forms retain their current contracts. In those existing views constituents appear once and managed occurrence/quantity allocation remain unresolved. New view=option-structure returns OptionStructureCollection and may divide a holding into conserved allocated/residual integer quantities. It consumes only retained evidence in one query-only transaction, including Fidelity ledger rows without a prior history read. New snapshot-bound authenticated associations establish current membership; automatic brokerage grouping, occurrence continuity and opening attribution are unavailable in P2. Source/admission rules, exact payoff basis, errors and acquisition boundaries are specified in P2. No terminal presentation semantics. Existing common errors, exact Account authorization and no-store headers apply. Invalid selectors/repeated queries/GET bodies are422. Structural domain uncertainty is200; storage or16MiB response capacity failure503. No partial/truncated success.

post.summary: Retain and process a CSV Artifact
post.description:
Transactionally retain exact bytes and original filename before parsing. Same account/hash reuses generated immutable artifact identity; every upload records a filename/processing attempt. REJECTED processing is HTTP 200, source survives and prior admitted evidence remains. Positions admit snapshots. Other files admit source-row observations; History appends/matches exact row occurrences without deleting prior observations. Corrections, lifecycle projection and continuous-history coverage are unresolved. Interrupted calls may leave PENDING; inspect inventory then retry retained processing. File-type/source-period interpretations are bounded; filename account attribution is qualified when History/Balances omit account ID. Content/admission deduplicates; import-attempt identities do not. Import requires artifact write authority for the target Account only. Exact mixed-account originals are retained privately. Formats without supported row-level Account attribution are retained with REJECTED processing rather than admitting mixed rows. Complete original-file retrieval separately requires artifact read authority for every source Account; unregistered source scopes deny retrieval. Optional accountId narrows that scope and cannot expand authority. Account relationships are in representations, not URI ancestry. Aliases are never accepted as IDs. Upload requires filename-bearing Content-Disposition and X-Brokerage-File-Type; missing or invalid upload inputs return INVALID_REQUEST/422 before retaining bytes. The body media type must be text/csv (compatible parameters are allowed).

<!-- internal-only:start -->
Positions processing admits only target-account rows and does not grant access to other Accounts. Collections include only backend-authorized Account scope. Bearer credentials resolve to stable Users; permissions are read from committed backend User authority, independently of credential strings or Account ownership.
<!-- internal-only:end -->

### Supported Fidelity CSV exports

Submit existing Fidelity exports, preserving their envelope, case-sensitive column labels, account attribution and source dates. The type selects an interpretation; arbitrary CSV with similar values is not an interchangeable export. UTF-8 with an optional BOM and CSV quoting for commas, quotes and embedded newlines are supported. Required column labels describe export shape, not a requirement that every cell be nonblank.

| X-Brokerage-File-Type | Required columns | Export envelope and row rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POSITIONS | Account number; Account name; Investment type; Symbol; Description; Quantity; Current value; Total gain/loss dollar; Type | Start with the header row. Preserve the Date downloaded MMM-dd-yyyy footer and its remaining download-time text. Requested-account rows establish attribution; preserve their broker account identity. At least one requested-account row is required. Conflicting account names or truncated rows reject processing. Blank/-- quantities and Cash or missing investment types are excluded from holdings; a counted holding needs a Symbol. |
| ACTIVITY | Run Date; Action; Symbol; Amount ($) | History export with the header as the first nonblank row and original History_for_Account_{broker-account}.csv filename (supported broker download suffixes may follow the account token). Filename attribution is qualified because content omits account identity. Each data row needs a valid M/d/yyyy or M-d-yyyy Run Date and nonblank Action; Symbol may be blank. Rows must cover all header columns. Empty history can be accepted and does not establish lifetime coverage. |
| BALANCES | Balance; Day change | Balances export with the header as the first nonblank row and original Balances_for_Account_{broker-account}.csv filename (supported broker download suffixes may follow the account token). Attribution is qualified. At least one complete data row is required. Additional exported columns are retained as source observations; they do not themselves establish Portfolio Capital. |
| OPTION_SUMMARY | Symbol; Strategy; Expiration & Strike; Quantity | Preserve the opening Fidelity Investments - Option Summary {broker-account} section marker, optional Quote data as of metadata, and the subsequent header. At least one complete data row is required. Broker strategy presentation does not establish Position identity or share ownership. |

Brace-delimited account tokens above are placeholders, not example account numbers or Wheelwright accountId values. Preserve the broker-supplied filename and content instead of constructing attribution from a Wheelwright ID. Except for Positions' supported target-account row selection, unsupported mixed-account row attribution rejects processing. Preserve recognized broker footers; unknown envelopes, duplicate headers, malformed quoting or truncated data can fail processing. Balances and Option Summary retain source rows without inventing numeric or lifecycle meaning. History retains row occurrences; later normalized transaction reads apply their own date/decimal interpretation.

### Retention versus processing rejection

Missing/invalid upload headers, accountId, media type or byte size return 422 before source retention. After retention, unsupported brokerage/format, invalid UTF-8, unsupported account attribution, missing required columns/export date or malformed data produce HTTP 200 with status REJECTED and a safe result message. The source remains retained and prior admitted evidence remains intact; no partially admitted rows from the failed processing attempt become success. Inspect status, not HTTP 200 alone. A syntactically valid CSV request-shape example is not a promise of successful evidence admission. Retry reads the retained bytes and recorded filename/type; it cannot repair an incompatible source export.

parameters.name: Content-Disposition
parameters.description: A parseable Content-Disposition containing filename or RFC 5987 filename*. get.description:
Pure read of accepted retained originals in one committed inventory. One row per admitted Balances artifact; unique identical reported export-minute Option Summary produces Portfolio Capital = Total Account Value minus aggregate short-option MTM. This is a two-source composite, not an atomic brokerage observation. No same-day/nearest/predecessor pairing, daily collapse, interpolation, historical knowledge replay or NAV claim. Missing, malformed, ambiguous or unmatched required values remain null with explicit row status. Complete parsed Summary without short options establishes zero; missing MTM never does. ExportedAt has MINUTE precision in America/New_York, independently of quoteDate and receipt time. Every row preserves both source hashes/IDs/rows. Duplicate timestamps retain all Balance rows with AMBIGUOUS_EXPORT_MINUTE. Response order exportMinute ASC NULLS LAST then artifactId ASC. Coverage remains UNKNOWN. Complete collection with 10000 artifact/32MiB input limit; capacity or hash failure returns 503 without partial output. Non-Fidelity Account is 422.

<!-- internal-only:start -->
Required canonical accountId and existing account.artifacts.read grant; CLI resolves nicknames with account.read. Every original must have established single requested Account source scope, with existing original-disclosure protections, else whole read is 403. Only accountId is allowed, exactly once; all other/repeated/blank params and nonempty GET bodies are 422 after authentication and applicable Account authorization. Known authorized empty Account returns 200 empty.
<!-- internal-only:end -->

get.description:
Retained-first backend DB read; optional policy-bounded full source scan. Default read-through disabled; reuse 300 seconds when enabled. Source paging has one shared 10-second deadline, 100-page/25000-row/16MiB source limits; capacity or source failure never truncates into success. Complete scan admits atomically; failed scan preserves prior history and returns complete=false with retained/incomplete context. Provider source pages are not claimed atomic. Lifetime coverage remains UNKNOWN. No query parameters or GET body. Instance lookup never searches outside the selected Account. Complete bounded JSON only; 16MiB response capacity fails with 503. No orders, strategy grouping, tax or P/L computation. Fidelity serves retained admitted CSV activity without acquisition; row-equivalence identity does not establish a unique broker event. No-argument CLI history composes these Account-scoped resources.

<!-- internal-only:start -->
Explicit account.transactions.read grant required. Account and transaction IDs confer no permission. Original source access remains separately governed; the existing raw-artifact scope screen fails closed for unsupported transaction envelopes.
<!-- internal-only:end -->

StructuralRational.description: Exact reduced rational; denominator positive. Scalar decoding and viewport interpolation are presentation, not option valuation.

StructuralEvidence.description: Account-scoped evidence references only; no original payload, raw brokerage identifier, order detail or transaction money. IDs confer no artifact/history access. Time precision is not synthesized.

StructuralIdentity.description: P2 does not expose affirmative occurrence identity or infer continuity. subjectId and association IDs identify current snapshot projection/claims only; not economic occurrences.

StructuralUnits.description: Backend primitive-ratio units: GCD of absolute allocated integer option quantities; +2/-2/-4/+2 =>2 units of +1/-1/-2/+1. Single residual -3 =>3. Units are not count of managed Positions/openings. Invalid quantities cannot be established. Ratios and units are properties of current construction, never occurrence identity.

StructuralTerms.description: Positive physical single-underlying terms only. P2 standard-us-equity-v1 admits native Standard/100-share records under the documented adapter product rule. Adjusted acquisition is unsupported in P2; the curve model can represent independently qualified adjusted terms in a later reviewed admission lane.

StructuralStrategy.description: Construction classification only; credit in a name does not prove opening credit. NONSTANDARD with established terms is a valid shape, not failed recognition.

StructuralPayoff.description: Knots include x=0 and every positive slope-change point in strictly increasing order; y and right tail determine the continuous function on S>=0. No left/negative-price domain. Premium, basis, fees, tax, funding, cash collateral and execution excluded. Total actual allocated quantity, not per unit. Complete compatible terms required; no partial package payoff.

StructuralRange.description: Verified ordinary short-strike region for supported standard constructions; never breakevens. Nonstandard/adjusted structures may have established payoff with UNSUPPORTED range.

OptionStructure.description: subjectId is a response/snapshot-scoped projection key, never lifecycle identity. identity is established only from proven occurrence + construction boundaries. Unknown expiration remains represented; remainingDte null means unavailable. Clients do not reconstruct membership, identity, quantities or payoff.

OptionStructureCollection.description: P2 pure current snapshot structure projection. Occurrence/opening attribution explicitly unavailable. One query-only SQLite transaction and one evaluation instant; no provider contact, history GET, normalization writes or hidden identity creation. Database consistency is not broker atomicity.

ContractEvidenceAcquisition.description: One result per nonzero option holding in selected snapshot, including failed/unattempted subjects; zero options permits COMPLETE empty. COMPLETE means all required contract inputs admitted, never current holdings/history completeness. Does not acquire holdings or orders. Source failures preserve previous admitted evidence.
